# SPDX license name

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:spdxLicenseName`](gmeow-spdxLicenseName.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/spdxLicenseName>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/rights`](../../slices/rights.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The full SPDX [`License`](../classes/gmeow-License.md) List name of a licence ([spdx:name](http://spdx.org/rdf/terms#name)), e.g. "Apache [`License`](../classes/gmeow-License.md) 2.0".

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:License`](../classes/gmeow-License.md) -> [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal)

Use [`gmeow:spdxLicenseName`](gmeow-spdxLicenseName.md) from [`gmeow:License`](../classes/gmeow-License.md) to [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to carry the full human-readable SPDX List name of a licence ([spdx:name](http://spdx.org/rdf/terms#name)) alongside the short [`gmeow:spdxLicenseId`](gmeow-spdxLicenseId.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it as the machine-readable identifier (that is [`gmeow:spdxLicenseId`](gmeow-spdxLicenseId.md)) and avoid an invented name; use the exact SPDX List name.

### How to use

- Set [`gmeow:spdxLicenseName`](gmeow-spdxLicenseName.md) on a [`gmeow:License`](../classes/gmeow-License.md) to the exact SPDX List name for display, with [`gmeow:spdxLicenseId`](gmeow-spdxLicenseId.md) carrying the short id for matching.

### Examples

- ex:apacheLicense [`gmeow:spdxLicenseName`](gmeow-spdxLicenseName.md) "Apache [`License`](../classes/gmeow-License.md) 2.0".
